senses.definition: A person who loses; one who fails to win or thrive.
examples: In a two-horse race there is always one winner and one loser.
He was always a good loser.

senses.definition: A person who is frequently unsuccessful in life.
examples: That guy is a born loser!
I'm a constant loser in love.

quotes.text: Mike didn't work but insisted that Jewell have a job. He would stay home and do whatever — smoke pot, screw around. He was a total loser, and she picked up the slack. That's around the time that Mom met her soon-to-be-next husband. He immediately moved in. He was a loser, too, with the same work ethic Mike had.
